_comment: Civic incident categories. Add an entry to support a new category; no code change needed.

categories.label: Pothole / Road Damage
categories.title_placeholder: Large pothole near the main crossing
categories.description_placeholder: A deep pothole on the left side of the road. Vehicles swerve to avoid it.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Repair or make the damaged section safe.
Take a photo of the finished work from the same spot.

categories.label: Garbage / Cleanliness
categories.description_placeholder: Waste is piling up around the bin and spilling onto the road.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Clear the waste.
Take a photo of the cleaned area.

categories.label: Water Leakage
categories.title_placeholder: Water leaking from a pipeline at the corner
categories.description_placeholder: Clean water has been leaking onto the road since morning.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Stop or repair the leak, or note that it needs a specialist.
Take a photo showing the result.

categories.label: Drainage / Waterlogging
categories.description_placeholder: The roadside drain is blocked and water collects across the lane.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Clear the blockage.
Take a photo showing water flowing.

categories.label: Broken Streetlight
categories.description_placeholder: The streetlight has been off for a week and the lane is dark at night.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map and find the pole.
Repair or replace the light.
Take a photo showing the pole and the light.

categories.label: Damaged Public Infrastructure
categories.description_placeholder: The seat plank of the second bench from the gate is broken.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Repair or secure the asset.
Take a photo of the finished work.

categories.label: Public Safety Hazard
categories.description_placeholder: A large branch has fallen across the footpath; people are walking on the road.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Make the hazard safe or remove it.
Take a photo showing the cleared area.

categories.label: Public toilet maintenance
categories.title_placeholder: Public toilet near the bus stand is not clean
categories.description_placeholder: What is wrong: cleanliness, water, lights, broken doors or fittings?
categories.asset_hint: Name or number on the building, if any
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Clean, repair or restore the facility.
Take a photo of the finished work from the same spot.

categories.label: Sanitation and cleanliness
categories.title_placeholder: Street not swept near the market
categories.description_placeholder: Describe the cleanliness problem and how long it has been there.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Clean the area.
Take a photo of the clean area from the same spot.

categories.label: Waste disposal
categories.description_placeholder: What kind of waste, how much, and is anyone burning it?
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Collect and remove the waste to the proper disposal point.
Take a photo of the cleared spot from the same place.

categories.label: Highway problem
categories.title_placeholder: Large crack across the highway lane
categories.description_placeholder: Which highway, which direction, and what is the danger?
instructions: Go to the pin on the map and secure the area.
Repair or make the carriageway safe.
Take a photo of the finished work from the same spot.

categories.label: Other Civic Issue
categories.description_placeholder: Describe the issue in your own words.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Resolve the issue.
Take a photo of the result.

categories.label: Medical Assistance
categories.description_placeholder: What happened, how many people, are they conscious?
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Give first aid and call the medical team if needed.
Record what was done.

categories.label: Crowd Management
categories.title_placeholder: Crowd building up at the food court exit
categories.description_placeholder: Where is the crowd, how dense is it, is anyone at risk?
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Open alternate routes and guide people.
Report when the area is clear.

categories.label: Security Concern
categories.title_placeholder: Unattended bag near the main stage
categories.description_placeholder: Describe what you saw. Do not approach anything dangerous.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Secure the area and follow the security protocol.
Record the outcome.

categories.label: Missing Person
categories.title_placeholder: Child separated from parents near Zone B
categories.description_placeholder: Age, clothing and where the person was last seen.
instructions: Go to the last-seen location.
Search the nearby area and alert the help desk.
Record when the person is found.

categories.label: Operational / Maintenance Issue
categories.title_placeholder: Power out at the ticket counter
categories.description_placeholder: What is not working and how it affects the event.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Fix the issue or call the right vendor.
Record the result.
